queries.query: For those who got the least rest, what fraction of the learned material survived until breakfast?
queries.target_quote: Students who slept less than six hours kept only 71 percent of the pairs they had recalled the evening before.

queries.query: How strongly were the short bursts of fast brain rhythm tied to how much was remembered the next day?
queries.target_quote: Each additional spindle per minute of N2 sleep predicted a gain of 4.2 points in morning recall, and spindle density explained more of the differences between students than total sleep time did.

queries.query: 入睡要花多长时间，会影响第二天还记得多少吗？
queries.target_quote: Retention did not depend on how long it took the students to fall asleep.
Sleep was recorded at home with a two-channel EEG headband that the students applied themselves.
